name: twg
description: Query and manage Atlassian Teamwork Graph data (Jira, Confluence, Atlas, Loom, Bitbucket, Google Docs, Sharepoint) via the TWG CLI.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: TWG command arguments (e.g., 'jira workitem get --id PROJ-123', 'docs query --since 7d').

usage_guidance: Surface routing: Use federated surfaces first (docs, videos, meetings, spaces) for cross-product queries. Use native surfaces (jira, confluence, bitbucket, goals, projects, teams) for product-specific detail or mutations. Use projection surfaces (work, context, org-tree) for activity, hierarchy, and issue context. Workflow: 1) Pick the right surface. 2) Run 'twg <surface> <resource> --help' for flag details. 3) Execute. 4) If empty results, pivot to next surface family (federated->native). 5) Summarize key IDs/titles/statuses/URLs. Common commands: 'docs query --since 7d', 'videos query', 'meetings --since 14d --with-recordings', 'spaces query --keyword <term>', 'work query --scope me --since 7d', 'org-tree --name "Jane Doe" --up-only', 'context jira workitem PROJ-123 --depth 2', 'jira workitem get --id PROJ-123', 'confluence pages get 12345 --body-format adf', 'goals --scope me', 'projects --scope me --role contributor', 'teams query --query Platform', 'user-search --name "Jane Doe"', 'resolve --name "Jane Doe"'. For large goal exports use --sqlite-file. State intended changes before write operations. Prefer ADF bodies for Confluence pages. Do not generate storage XML.
returns: Command output from the TWG CLI (typically structured text or JSON).
examples: twg confluence search query --cql 'type=page AND contributor=currentUser() ORDER BY lastmodified DESC'
